display_name: 生产恢复器与冻结识别器特征复用：源样本梯度检查
description: 原JointPrior固定E30权重载入相同FeatureResponse G结构；合法源L/U各一条、四方向，CPU比较原训练图和共享F0特征图的损失、真实G梯度和一次局部AdamW。
authorization: 用户授权源L_s/U_s和冻结F0性能/效率诊断；无TX/V/OE/target。只在独立进程的G副本执行比较性一步AdamW，不覆盖已存或在训模型。

metric_names: Actual original-F0 reference feature, full physical+detail+IQ/F0 response loss, restored/altered IQ and production G parameter gradients, local AdamW step maximum differences.
Verify F0 state unchanged, source-only G provenance and no source TX/V/OE/target; fixed global prior, CPU only.

two odd epochs covering four deterministic source perturbation directions
original FeatureResponse readout vs equivalent cached/shared readout
metrics_plan.prediction_ref: No target or truth predictions. Fixed source records, F0 continuous features and source simulator trace.
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Numerical tolerance assertions inside independent CPU process; no truth scoring.

rows.purpose: Compare complete FeatureResponse source loss, actual production-G gradients and local AdamW step under exact same frozen source F0 and fixed original G state.
rows.seed_notes: Fixed source-only JointPrior E30 seed2026092701; source indices0 and6301 and odd source epochs1/3; no target-based selection.
rows.scenario: Original R07 draw1 source2 IQ/simulator traces; fixed global prior and four perturbation directions.
rows.optimizer: Fresh local AdamW lr.001 weight_decay1e-4, one comparison step for each path and epoch; no saved or active G training update.
rows.budget_ref: CPU2; 2 cases, 2 independent original/shared real-G copies per case, total4 temporary local AdamW steps, no production state write.

notes: CPU only and fixed global prior: does not establish numerical parity on GPU, other-RX prior, full training trajectory, speed or target accuracy.
